basic_details.short_information: South Western Railway (SWR), Hubballi, Karnataka, has invited applications for 258 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. No.01/2026(GDCE). The posts include Goods Train Manager, JE / Bridge, JE / P.Way, JE / Mechanical Workshop and 1 more. The online application is open from 9 November 2026 to 8 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SWR Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Go to RRC/SWR website www.rrchubli.in and click on the application portal provided in the website. Follow the steps outlined under the heading HOW TO APPLY and complete all the required details. Upload supporting documents wherever mandatory. Preview the application, submit it, and download or take a printout of the application. Apply on or before 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SWR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 8 December 2026. Applications opened on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SWR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 258 vacancies: 247 Goods Train Manager, 2 JE / Bridge, 2 JE / P.Way, 5 JE / Mechanical Workshop, 2 JE / S&T / Signal.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SWR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 42 years (as on 1 January 2027). Relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC 3.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per direct recruitment rules of RRBs.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree or Diploma in Engineering or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only regular serving railway employees of South Western Railway and RWF/YNK are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Staff in RPF/RPSF. Assistant Commissioner and Accounts Cadre.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Computer Based Test (CBT). Document Verification. Medical Examination. Single stage Computer Based Test (CBT).

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the SWR exam?
faq.answer: There will be negative marking in CBT examination and marks will be deducted for each wrong answer @ 1/3rd of the marks allotted for each question.
